title: CLI mailbox read text hint for an omitted own-send body should carry the caller's --as-session (and --base-url)
outcome:
`termal mailbox read` text output prints, for the reader's own send, "(body omitted: your own message; read it with `termal mailbox read-message --message-id <id>`)". The hint leaves out the identity and URL the read used. If the operator ran `mailbox read --as-session X` (or `--base-url U`) explicitly, the copied hint runs as TERMAL_SESSION_ID against the default URL, and is refused or is a usage error. The fix passes the MailboxRead `as_session` (and any explicit base URL) to the hint, sanitized, or words the hint and doc as "with the same --as-session". docs/features/coordination-cli.md should match.

Optional tightening from the same review's Note, not reachable today: the read validation could also require that a message carrying bodyOmitted has senderSessionId equal to as_session. That would keep it exactly in step with the bridge's projection rule.
acceptance: The text-form hint for an omitted own-send body names the --as-session (and --base-url when one was given) that the read used, sanitized; a CLI test covers an explicit --as-session read.
